title: Weak stability and binary convex combinations of slices
summary: We study weak openness and related geometric properties of convex combinations of slices of the unit balls of Banach spaces. We prove that, for every $m\geq 2$, properties $\mathrm{P1}^{(m)}$ and $\mathrm{CWO}^{(m)}$ are equivalent, and likewise for their closure variants. Consequently, both $\mathrm{P1}$ and $\overline{\mathrm{P1}}$ are determined by convex combinations of two slices; in particular P1 and CWO are equivalent.
